# Little Jem

## Overview

- **Age:** Around 7 years old by the end of Volume 4
- **Gender:** Male
- **Status:** Alive
- **Origin:** Four Winds Point, Prince Edward Island
- **Role:** Schoolboy
- **Nicknames:** Jem; Little Jem

## Appearance

Jem is a healthy, bright-eyed boy who inherits features from both of his parents. He has dark, curly hair like his father and expressive, intelligent eyes reminiscent of his mother. As he grows through his early childhood in Glen St. Mary, he develops a sturdy and active build.

## Personality

Jem is an imaginative, sensitive, and brave young boy with a deep love for nature and storytelling. He possesses a strong sense of loyalty and affection toward his family, especially his mother and his beloved dog. Like his mother, he has a vivid imagination and an eye for beauty, often finding magic in the natural world around Ingleside. He is also determined and stout-hearted when facing childhood troubles.

## Traits

- Imaginative and poetic
- Brave and loyal
- Deeply affectionate
- Animal lover

## Abilities

- Storytelling and imaginative play

## Goals

- To protect his loved ones and his pets

## History

James Matthew 'Little Jem' Blythe is born at Four Winds Point to Anne and Gilbert Blythe, bringing great joy to his parents following the tragic death of their firstborn infant, Joyce. He is named after Captain Jim and Matthew Cuthbert. During his early years at Four Winds, he is doted on by his parents, Susan Baker, and Leslie Moore. When Gilbert's medical practice expands, the Blythe family moves to Ingleside in Glen St. Mary, where Jem grows up alongside his younger siblings, Walter, the twins Anne (Nan) and Diana (Di), and Shirley. At Ingleside, Jem enjoys an idyllic childhood filled with adventures in the surrounding fields and hollows. He forms a deep attachment to his dog, Bruno, and faces the heartbreak and relief surrounding his pet's welfare. As he begins attending school, Jem learns to navigate local childhood rivalries while remaining a compassionate and imaginative member of the Blythe household.

## Background by volume

- Firstborn surviving child of Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe
- Born at the house of dreams in Four Winds Point after the loss of his elder sister Joyce
- Moved with his family to Ingleside in Glen St. Mary as a toddler

## Affiliations

- The Blythe Family — Eldest son
